name: Bad Fallingbostel (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Fallingbostel (two horse's heads above a beehive on white and blue waves).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Fallingbostel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Fallingbostel arms — horse's heads and beehive
